summary: Russian missile strikes on Odesa and Zaporizhzhia killed three civilians and injured 20, including five children. Ukrainian Neptune missiles destroyed tactical UAV production and FPV drone repair facilities in Rostov-on-Don. Massive coordinated drone waves and guided aerial bomb strikes occurred across northern, eastern, and southern Ukraine.

Ukrainian drones conducted 13th strike on Volgograd Lukoil refinery, also hitting Samara pipeline infrastructure and Rostov region ammunition depots. (Source: @UkraineNow/85272)

Finland allocated €37.3 million for Ukrainian defense sector support and critical infrastructure reconstruction, including Finnish business engagement. (Source: @UkraineNow/85275)
eRadarrua fundraising for charging station for 23rd Brigade drone battalion to ensure uninterrupted power for UAV operations. (Source: @eRadarrua/130535)
Russian missile strikes on Odesa killed two civilians and injured seven; Zaporizhzhia strike killed a 17-year-old and injured 13 including five children. (Source: @UkraineNow/85280)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are intensifying multi-domain pressure with simultaneous missile strikes on southern cities, guided bomb campaigns in the east, and massive drone waves across the north. The Rostov strikes demonstrate Ukraine's growing ability to degrade Russian drone production and repair chains. ISW's assessment that Putin may exploit a local ceasefire to regroup for a Druzhkivka offensive aligns with observed civilian evacuations from Kostyantynivka. The FAA ground stop and US internet outages, if linked to Russian hybrid activity, would indicate escalation beyond the immediate theater. Russian satellite program failures further constrain their long-term C4ISR capabilities.
sections.regional_response: European unity on Ukraine financing is hardening, with Sweden's Kristersson explicitly opposing national opt-outs and supporting frozen asset utilization. Finland's €37.3M package adds to bilateral support. The bipartisan US House demand for Starshield restoration signals congressional pushback against potential Trump administration restrictions. EU leaders' two-week timeline to decide on negotiation representation reflects urgency to coordinate a unified stance before any Trump-Putin-Xi meeting. Peskov's NATO non-expansion demand remains a static rhetorical position.
sections.intelligence_notes: The "Dan-T" barrage munition's first documented ground launch suggests Russian adaptation of air-dropped systems for artillery-like saturation fires. The scale of the November 14 drone wave — spanning Bryansk to Black Sea launch points — indicates improved Russian coordination of multi-axis UAV operations. Ukrainian targeting of "Ionos" and "Aero-Hit" facilities shows precise intelligence on Russian tactical UAV supply chains. The "Rassvet" constellation's failure to reach operational orbits confirms systemic Russian space industry deficits. The Moscow car bombing of an identified SVR influence officer points to internal Russian security fractures or Ukrainian partisan activity.
